verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-agent infrastructure platform, so a public marketplace for monetizing scrapers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only deploying agents, ready-made templates, and reusable scripts. Nothing documents publishing a scraper publicly or earning revenue from other users. The 30+ templates are first-party starter content, not a developer marketplace.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it
